input.request: Release Plain Demo (PLAIN), an ERC-20 with total supply 1,000,000,000 tokens, 18 decimals and plain transfers. Mint once to the deployer; no later minting, transfer taxes, rebasing, admin or upgrade. Use standard launch allocation: 10% to the swarm and 90% to the pool. Build and test, independently review, deploy on Sepolia, then host a read-only website displaying the verified contract address, total supply and connected wallet balance. Access control: anyone can transfer their own tokens and approve allowances; transferFrom requires sufficient allowance. There are no owner-only functions or privileged settings. Wallet connection is for balance reads only, with no write buttons, signatures or transactions.
input.context: Sepolia chain 11155111 only. GitHub and IPFS publication approved for this example. The deployer executes deployment; users pay gas for token transfers for their own benefit. Website reads need no transaction. No background automation.

draft.objective: Build, test and independently review PLAIN with total supply 1,000,000,000 and 18 decimals. Deploy and publish a read-only token dashboard against verified addresses.

steps.objective: Show chain, deployed token address, supply and wallet balance; show loading and RPC error states.
